items.title: Galaundi section of Prithvi Highway to be closed for six hours at night for repairs
items.summary: Dhadhing, October 12 Vehicular movement will be completely closed from tonight on the Galaundi section of the Prithvi Highway in Gajuri, Dhading, which sank due to erosion by the Trishuli River, as further repairs are needed. According to the District Administration Office, Dhading, vehicles have been barred from the section to allow further repair and […] The post Galaundi section of Prithvi High

items.title: Bridge washed away by torrent of water in Nepal
items.summary: Flash floods along Nepal’s Budhi Gandaki River swept away homes and bridges, forcing residents to flee to higher ground.

items.title: Flood damage makes journeys longer and costlier in Rasuwa
items.summary: Many settlements across the district have become inaccessible after the August 26 flood damaged roads and bridges. In Amachhodingmo, dwindling relief supplies are adding to residents’ hardship.

items.title: Bhotekoshi flood wasn’t a freak event. It’s the Himalaya doing what it does
items.summary: From the 51,000-year-old Tsergo Ri collapse to the 2015 Langtang landslide, rockfalls are part of the Himalayan ecosystem, and global warming is making them more dangerous.

items.title: ‘It reminded me of the Bhotekoshi floods’: Gorkha residents recount escape
items.summary: A flash flood in the Budhi Gandaki swept away houses and bridges early Sunday, forcing residents of Chumnubri and Dharche to flee to higher ground in the dark. Five people are missing, and six have been rescued by air.

items.title: Bailey bridge restores road link between Rasuwa and Nuwakot after six weeks
items.summary: A 73-metre bridge over the Phalakhu river has reopened the route between the two districts, whose road connection was severed by floods in August.

items.title: Landslide may have triggered flash flooding in Budhi Gandaki, officials say
items.summary: A landslide in Chumchet may have blocked a tributary before water surged downstream. Authorities warn of high flood risks along the Trishuli river as far as Chitwan and Nawalparasi.
